title: fm-guard.sh and git hooks: nobody writes to main
acceptance: fm-guard.sh refuses main, master and a detached HEAD, and honours FM_PROTECTED
pre-commit blocks a commit on a protected branch and allows one on a feature branch
pre-push blocks a push whose target ref is a protected branch
the hooks are self-contained: they must not depend on bin/ existing in the worktree being committed to
branch protection on GitHub has enforce_admins on, since firstmate runs on the captain's own credentials
